data.title: Biographical Notes – Mariève B. Tremblay
data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: Ms. Mariève B. Tremblay is a senior executive, lawyer and corporate director with more than 25 years of leadership experience across the transportation and logistics, energy, mining, and industrial sectors. She has held executive and leadership positions with major Canadian and international organizations, including CN, Nature Energy, The CSL Group, Alcan/Rio Tinto, and Bombardier. Her mandates have encompassed corporate strategy, business development and commercial leadership, procurement and supply chain, technology and cybersecurity, environmental, social and governance (ESG) matters, corporate partnerships, and business transformation.

data.title: Biographical Notes – Francis A. Mensah
data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: Mr. Francis A. Mensah has served as Vice-President, Finance and Administration, and Chief Financial Officer at the Royal Canadian Mint since 2022. Prior to this role, Mr. Mensah served as Deputy Chief Risk Officer at the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC) and Director of Corporate Accounting at Export Development Canada (EDC).

data.title: Biographical Notes – Ellen Yifan Chen
data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: Ms. Ellen Yifan Chen is a corporate executive, trilingual lawyer, and governance specialist with extensive experience in enterprise risk management, digital transformation, and finance, bringing over a decade of board-level stewardship.

data.title: Pirutsiagutiit National Framework
data.author: Indigenous Services Canada
data.summary: Pirutsiagutiit, meaning "resources for growing well" in Inuktut, is a new Inuit-led program that will help Inuit children access the health, social and educational products, services and supports they need. The program will launch on April 1, 2027, replacing the interim Inuit Child First Initiative.
